### Lord of the Nations
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/lord-of-nations
Passage: 2 Kings 8:7-15
Points:
- God exercises sovereign dominion over all nations and their rulers, not just His covenant people.
- Even pagan kings like Ben-hadad recognized the authority of the true God when facing crisis.
- The Lord foreordains world events and leaders without approving of their evil deeds.
- God uses foreign rulers to discipline His people while still holding those rulers accountable for their cruelty.
- Believers can find comfort knowing that the rise and fall of earthly powers serves God's ultimate purpose.

### Bible Pathways - May 3, 2008
Author: Bible Pathways Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-may-3-2008-11574746.html
Passage: 2 Kings 8:12-15
Points:
- Unchecked ambition and greed blind individuals to the cruel actions they can commit.
- Hazael was indignant at the prophecy of his brutality, yet acted upon it once opportunity arrived.
- Unlike David, who refused to murder Saul for the crown, Hazael took matters into his own hands.
- Believers stay safe from destructive sin only by yielding their desires to God's Word.
